title: 三脚付きビデオカメラ
description: 公共スタジオ・催事会場で据えて使う無銘のビデオカメラ一式。二本管の三脚と伸縮部外形、開脚補強、固定パン/チルトヘッドと操作棒、レンズの実開口フードと角形遮光枠、無表示の開いた側面画面、上部取手・後部バッテリーを造形。監視用壁付カメラとは異なる撮影機材です。レンズ面は不透明PBRで、録画・光学・画面表示・首振り機能や支持荷重は検証していません。 ゲーム・可視化向け。製造・構造設計・3Dプリント用途は未検証。 外接寸法（X×Y×Z）1.017 × 1.721 × 0.960 m、13,696三角形。単位m・Y-up、水平中央の接地用原点、最下点Y=0。部品ごとの重複UV0と単色PBR材質を収録し、画像テクスチャ・UV2・コライダー・LOD・リグ・動作は付属しません。静的表示用でUnity/VRChat実機検証は未実施。STLはm・Y-up座標の形状のみで色・材質・UV・階層を含みません。
descriptionEn: An unbranded camera assembly for public studios and event venues. It has a twin-tube tripod with telescoping exteriors and spreaders, fixed pan/tilt head and control arm, truly open lens hood and rectangular shade, open blank side screen, top handle and rear battery. It is filming equipment rather than a wall-mounted security camera. The lens is an opaque PBR face; recording, optics, display, movement and support-load performance are not implemented or validated. For games and visualization; not validated for manufacture, structural engineering or 3D printing. Bounding dimensions (X×Y×Z): 1.017 × 1.721 × 0.960 m; 13,696 triangles. Metres, Y-up, horizontally centered placement origin with minimum Y=0, not an articulation or wall-mount pivot. Includes overlapping component UV0 and constant-color PBR materials, with no image textures, unique UV2, colliders, LOD, rig or runtime behavior. Static visualization only; Unity/VRChat editor and runtime tests have not been performed. STL uses metre-valued Y-up coordinates and contains geometry only, without color, materials, UVs or hierarchy.
author: Xenoah
uv: Per-component primitive or automatically unwrapped UVs. Overlapping between components; not a packed unique lightmap atlas. Solid-color PBR materials; no external textures. STL has no colors or UVs.
